text: . India’s men’s and women’s teams will compete in the finals of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad today. The Indian women’s team will take on Uganda in the final this evening. The match is scheduled to begin at 7:30 PM IST.India booked their place in the title clash with a convincing 39-14 victory over Sri Lanka in yesterday’s semi-final. Meanwhile, the Indian men’s team will face Sri Lanka in the final at 9:00 PM Indian time. Indian men’s team secured their spot in the championship clash with a dominant 56-27 win over Bangladesh in the semi-finals.

. In Men’s Cricket, India will face hosts New Zealand in the fifth and final T20 International today at Seddon Park in Hamilton. The match will begin at 12:30 PM Indian Standard Time. India are leading the series 3-1.India won the first three matches while New Zealand bounced back with a victory in the fourth match in Auckland last Friday. The visitors will now look to finish the series with a win.Following the T20 International series, India and New Zealand will play a five-match ODI series beginning on November 4. This will be followed by a two-match Test series, starting on November 19.

. India has asserted that military solutions cannot resolve global challenges and that diplomacy must be given an opportunity to address conflicts. Speaking at the first plenary session of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, the United States, last night, External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar stressed the need to preserve freedom of navigation and ensure an end to attacks on civilian shipping and seafarers, in accordance with international law, particularly the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). His remarks come amid ongoing conflicts in different parts of the world, including the Russia-Ukraine war and escalating tensions in West Asia.Dr Jaishankar said that countries of the Global South are disproportionately bearing the consequences of attacks on civilian shipping and seafarers. He noted that such attacks are threatening the availability of essential commodities, including fuel, food and fertilisers, and driving up their costs. At least 22 Indians, including 14 seafarers, have lost their lives in West Asia since the conflict began in February this year.The External Affairs Minister, who reached Atlanta on Thursday, also held interactions with his counterparts from several countries ahead of the meeting.Dr Jaishankar will also participate in a QUAD Foreign Ministers’ Meeting with his counterparts from Japan, Australia and the United States on the sidelines of the G20 meeting. The United States is scheduled to host the G20 Leaders’ Summit in Miami on 14 and 15 December.Following his engagements in Atlanta, Dr Jaishankar is scheduled to travel to St John’s, Antigua and Barbuda, to lead India’s delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, scheduled from 1 to 4 November.

. Petroleum and Natural Gas Minister Hardeep Singh Puri has criticised the Congress for calling a rally today, which coincides with the 42nd anniversary of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. Addressing the media in New Delhi, Mr Puri questioned the intention of the Congress in holding a rally on a sensitive day for the Sikh community. He also expressed concern that today’s rally will disrupt the pre-Diwali market across the Chandni Chowk area.

. Union Home Minister Amit Shah today attended the 60th Raising Day celebrations of the Chandigarh Police as the chief guest at the Police Lines in Sector 26, Chandigarh. He inspected the police parade and took the salute during the march past.On this occasion, he presented President’s Medals to Chandigarh Police officers and personnel and also bestowed the prestigious ‘President’s Police Colour’ approved by President Droupadi Murmu upon the Chandigarh Police.Extending his heartfelt congratulations on the Chandigarh Police’s Raising Day and the receipt of the ‘President’s Police Colour,’ the Union Home Minister lauded the force for its six decades of service and dedication.The Union Home Minister remarked that even during the era of terrorism, the Chandigarh Police demonstrated exceptional courage and valour; through their bravery, service, and commitment to good governance, they played a pivotal role in shielding Chandigarh from the scourge of terrorism. He noted that since Chandigarh serves as the joint capital for both Punjab and Haryana, it often becomes a focal point for various challenges. Nevertheless, the Chandigarh Police has consistently maintained law and order by effectively coordinating with both the Haryana and Punjab Police forces.During the event, he also inducted 141 new vehicles into the Chandigarh Police fleet, stating that this would further improve the force’s response time. Shortly, the Union Home Minister will lay the foundation stones for and inaugurate several projects in Chandigarh.

. Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has emphasised that country’s next phase of economic transformation must be driven by young entrepreneurs who look beyond the domestic market and aspire to build world-class brands. He said this while interacting with students at the Festival of Ideas, held in New Delhi today.Mr Goyal said that with an expanding start-up ecosystem, manufacturing capabilities, various free trade agreements and deeper integration with global value chains, country offers immense opportunities for young Indians to createglobally competitive enterprises and generate employment. The Minister also encouraged the youth to seize emerging opportunities across manufacturing, deep technology and high-value services with a strong export-oriented mindset,globally benchmarked quality, industry-relevant skills and the confidence to take calculated risks.

. President Droupadi Murmu has greeted people of Andhra Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Chandigarh, Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Haryana, Karnataka, Keralam, Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh, Puducherry, Punjab and Tamil Nadu on the Formation Day of the States and Union Territories. In a social media post, the President said, these States and Union Territories, with their rich cultural heritage and diverse traditions, have played an important role in powering India’s growth. She also extended her best wishes for the prosperity and well-being of the people of these States and UTs.

. In badminton, India are assured of a place in the women’s singles final at the Hylo Open in Germany, as PV Sindhu and Anmol Kharb have set up an all-Indian semi-final clash following impressive quarter-final victories.Sindhu cruised past Germany’s Amalie Schulz in straight games, winning 21-12, 21-10. Anmol, meanwhile, put up a spirited fight to overcome sixth seed Unnati Hooda 21-17, 18-21, 21-16 in a three-game encounter.The two Indian shuttlers will now face each other in the semi-finals today, guaranteeing India a place in the title clash.

. The inaugural Financial Action Task Force, FATF, Plenary meeting under the UK Presidency of Giles Thomson has concluded in Paris, with member countries agreeing to step up global action against evolving financial crime threats, including the misuse of virtual assets, fraud and scam compounds.According to the FATF statement of outcomes, the Plenary agreed to accelerate the effective implementation of FATF standards on virtual assets in jurisdictions with significant virtual asset activity. The decision follows the FATF Ministerial Declaration of April 2026. The Plenary also stressed the urgent need to strengthen national safeguards against the misuse of virtual assets for money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing.In another significant decision, FATF agreed to remove Bulgaria, Côte d’Ivoire, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Monaco from its list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring following successful on-site visits. The FATF also updated its statements on jurisdictions under increased monitoring and those subject to a call for action.

. Massive protests took place in Europe yesterday as part of demonstrations driven by the cost of living and deficient public services, with police bracing for potential violence after recent looting and riots.Germany, France, Portugal and Serbia are among the nations where demonstrations held on Halloween following a recent wave of Gen Z-led marches across the continent. Akashvani correspondent reports that in France, Police have fired tear gas to disperse protesters in Paris and Lyon, as hundreds of thousands of young people took to the streets across the country to demand better education and lower living costs.The demonstrations in Paris began peacefully but later turned violent near the designated endpoint of the main march. Around 70,000 police personnel and gendarmes were deployed across France to maintain law and order. The Interior Ministry said at least 290 people had been arrested nationwide.Meanwhile, in Germany, hooded protesters looted shops in Frankfurt yesterday following demonstrations by tens of thousands of people demanding improved education facilities and a reduction in the cost of living. The protests, organised by a campaign group were held in 34 cities, including Berlin, Frankfurt and Munich. Around 60 people were arrested on charges including property damage and assault. In Serbia, student-led activism helped unseating the country’s long-time leader through the ballot box. Similar youth-led demonstrations were also reported in other European countries, including Portugal.

. The Indian women’s team has become the champion of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad. India clinched the gold medal after registering a convincing 35-15 victory over Uganda in the final this evening. With this triumph, the Indian women’s team has made history by winning the maiden edition of the championship on home soil. Meanwhile, the Indian men’s team will face Sri Lanka in the final at 9:00 PM Indian time. Indian men’s team secured their spot in the championship clash with a dominant 56-27 win over Bangladesh in the semi-finals.

. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 30 paise to close at 94 rupees and 95 paise against the US dollar.The dollar index, which indicates US dollar’s strength against a basket of six other leading currencies, was trading at 101.67 in intra-day trade.

. The Centre has withdrawn the special additional excise duty on petrol exports while increasing export levies on diesel and aviation turbine fuel ATF. According to notifications issued by the Ministry of Finance, under the revised rates, petrol exports will attract no export duty, compared to the earlier levy of 2 rupees 50 paise per litre.The export duty on diesel has been increased from eight rupees 50 paise to 11 rupees 50 paise per litre, while the levy on ATF has been raised from 10 rupees 50 paise to 11 rupees per litre. The revised rates came as the government continues its fortnightly review of fuel export duties in response to fluctuations in international crude oil and refined petroleum product prices.

. India’s men’s and women’s teams have stormed into the finals of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship being held in Ahmedabad.In the women’s semi-finals yesterday, India registered a convincing 39-14 victory over Sri Lanka, taking a commanding 24-7 lead at half-time. Uganda edged past Kenya 23-21 in the other semi-final.The women’s final between India and Uganda will be played at 7:30 PM Indian Standard Time today. The two teams will meet again following their group-stage encounter, in which India registered a 41-18 victory.Meanwhile, the Indian men’s team stormed into the final with a dominant 56-27 win over Bangladesh in the semi-finals. In the other semi-final, Sri Lanka defeated Kenya 28-24. The men’s final between India and Sri Lanka will take place at 9 PM today.

. President Droupadi Murmu has said that the nationwide Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao campaign has proved to be an important milestone in promoting women’s empowerment. The Campaign was launched from Panipat in Haryana in January 2015. She highlighted that the Child Sex Ratio at birth, which stood at 871 girls per one thousand boys in 2014, has increased to around 915 in November 2025. President Murmu said this while addressing the state-level Haryana Day celebrations in Kurukshetra, marking the 60th anniversary of the formation of Haryana. She said that Haryana has made remarkable progress over the past decade invarious dimensions of women’s empowerment.President Murmu said that Haryana’s daughters have brought laurels to the country at international sporting events. She highlighted that countless daughters, including Manu Bhaker, Saweety Boora and Jaismine Lamboria, are making Haryana and the nation proud through their remarkable achievements. The President said that the athletes from Haryana have made exceptional contributions to India’s sporting history, achieving outstanding success at the Olympic Games, Paralympic Games, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games and World Championships.Speaking on the occasion, Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini said that hardworking farmers, brave soldiers, accomplished sportspersons and empowered women are the identity of Haryana. He said that when Haryana was formed on this day in 1966, it was considered a backward region. However, today Haryana is counted among the leading states of the country. Mr Saini said that this achievement belongs not to any one individual but to the collective efforts of farmers, labourers, entrepreneurs, traders, sportspersons and women.He said that the daughters of Haryana are bringing laurels to the state in every field, from agriculture and sports to the armed forces and start-ups. Mr. Saini highlighted that Haryana contributes approximately 3.6 per cent to India’s GDP. He said that the state has become the first in the country to procure 24 crops from farmers at the Minimum Support Price. The Chief Minister said that Haryana’s sportspersons have made the country proud on the international stage.

. The government has constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to review the country’s banking sector and recommend reforms in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047.The Finance Ministry said that the Committee will recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms to make the Indian banking sector globally competitive, financially inclusive and resilient. The Committee will be chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel.Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Indian Bank Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan will be its members. The Joint Secretary (Banking) in the Department of Financial Services will serve as the Member Secretary. The Committee will have a tenure of six months. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman had announced the setting up of the Committee in her Budget speech this year.The Committee will assess existing banking practices and prudential norms, identify global best practices and examine their suitability for adoption in the Indian banking system. It will also review the existing regulatory and legal frameworks governing banks, including Regional Rural Banks and Cooperative Banks, and suggest reforms to improve efficiency and ease of banking.In addition, the Committee will prepare a roadmap for the adoption of artificial intelligence and digital innovations in banking institutions, while recommending safeguards against cyber risks.

. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold shed over one and a half per cent to 1,40,054 rupees per 10 grams. Meanwhile, silver plunged 4.8 per cent to 1,81,344 rupees per kilogram, according to the closing rates from the India Bullion and Jewellers Association.

. Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat today highlighted that India’s civilizational consciousness will offer valuable guidance in dealing with present day challenges in the country. The Minister stated this at the book launch of Timeless India: Protection and Revival of Indian Cultural Identity under the leadership of the Prime Minister in New Delhi. Mr Shekhawat said that this book offers a unique perspective on the initiatives undertaken by the government to safeguard and revive India’s rich cultural heritage. He emphasised that preserving and revitalising this legacy is essential not only for safeguarding the country’s historical identity but also for shaping its future.This book is written by Former Rajya Sabha Member Tarun Vijay and  published by Indira Gandhi National Centre of Arts and Surbhi publication.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved the Northern Bullet Train Corridor, which will connect Delhi to Guwahati via Siliguri. This was disclosed by Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw in Varanasi yesterday. The Minister was in the city to flag off the Varanasi-New Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper Express. Mr Vaishnaw said the Northern Bullet Train Corridor aims to revolutionise connectivity across northern and eastern India, cutting down the current 20-hour journey between Delhi and Siliguri to just six hours.The high-speed rail corridor will cover approximately 1,500 km and will pass through key cities across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal before extending into Assam. The key stations include Delhi, Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Patna, Siliguri, and Guwahati. Mr Vaishnaw said that ticket fares will be highly economical and significantly lower than airfares. He said the high-speed rail network is designed to boost small-scale industries, directly benefiting middle-income households, youth, and local artisans.

. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said, his government is considering to issue a formal apology for Britain’s role in the trans-Atlantic slave trade for the first time, as it seeks to strengthen ties with African and Caribbean nations. Burnham is scheduled to travel to Antigua and Barbuda next week to attend a meeting of Commonwealth leaders.In an article published in a British newspaper, Burnham said Britain must acknowledge its complicated history to safeguard the future of the Commonwealth, a grouping of 56 independent nations that largely evolved from the former British Empire.  He said the British government was prepared to initiate a structured dialogue with communities and nations affected by slavery and would listen to calls for a formal apology from the British state. However, he ruled out financial reparations for the slave trade, saying Britain would continue to resist demands for compensation.The Prime Minister also highlighted contemporary challenges facing Commonwealth members, including mounting debt burdens in developing countries, alongside wider economic, environmental and security concerns. Burnham’s remarks come as Britain seeks to reinforce its longstanding relationships with Commonwealth nations amid growing global economic, environmental and military challenges

. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has said that a depression over the South-east Bay of Bengal has moved west-northwestwards and intensified into a Deep Depression. It lay centred over the Southeast and adjoining Southwest Bay of Bengal and about 700 kilometres east-southeast of Chennai in Tamil Nadu and 770 kilometres south-southeast of Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh. IMD said it is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify into a Cyclonic Storm over the southwest and adjoining West-central Bay of Bengal during the next six hours and into a Severe Cyclonic Storm by tomorrow. It is very likely to cross the southern Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of 100 to 110 kilometres per hour, gusting to 120 kilometres per hour between Nellore and Narsapur by Tuesday morning.

. The Indian men’s and women’s teams became champions of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad last night. The Indian Men’s team clinched the gold medal after defeating Sri Lanka 54 – 20 in the final. Earlier, the Indian women’s team also bagged a gold medal after registering a convincing 35-15 victory over Uganda in the final. With these victories, both the Indian men’s and women’s teams made history by winning the maiden edition of the championship on home soil.

. Indian Railways has announced 1,265 vacancies for Station Master posts across various Railway Recruitment Boards and zones, opening up new employment opportunities for graduate candidates. The Railways Ministry said that in an important recruitment-related decision, the Railway Board has prescribed that Station Master recruitment will be notified separately from 2026 onwards. The dedicated recruitment process provides candidates with a specific notification covering eligibility requirements, examination procedures and vacancy distribution for the post. The online application window will remain open till 25th of next month. Candidates are advised to review the detailed eligibility conditions, vacancy distribution and application instructions before submitting their forms. The recruitment reflects Indian Railways’ continued efforts to provide career opportunities to eligible candidates while strengthening its operational workforce.

. Secretary of State of the United States and the Foreign Ministers of India, Australia, and Japan met in Atlanta, Georgia today to discuss progress on ongoing Quad initiatives and reaffirm their commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific.The Quad Joint Press Release on Economic Prosperity and Security said that the Quad ministers underscored the importance of economic security in maintaining global stability and prosperity.They reiterated their commitment to building reliable and open global supply chains and trusted and resilient infrastructure. They expressed grave concerns regarding economic coercion, including through arbitrary export restrictions, as well as non-market policies and practices that result in overcapacity to disrupt global supply chains in critical industries. They reiterated the absolute necessity to protect and preserve navigational rights and freedoms in the Strait of Hormuz, the Red Sea, and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait in accordance with international law as reflected in UNCLOS.The Quad ministers highlighted the importance of Artificial Intelligence and initiatives like Pax Silica to the future of economic growth and expressed their intent to provide over 85 million dollars of technical and financial assistance to support access to trusted SI across the Indo-Pacific, including through the Quad AI Accelerator.The Quad ministers expressed their deep concern about the proliferation of online and cyber scams that pose a threat to national and international peace and security. They condemned the criminal groups running the scam operations and trafficking people and forcing them to defraud our citizens, stealing tens of billions of dollars annually of hard-earned wealth from our respective countries.The Quad ministers expressed their condolences for those who lost their lives during the flash floods of 26th August in Nepal. They underscored their shared commitment to supporting partners in times of need. They recognized India’s leading role as the first responder to Nepal’s rescue, along with the significant support to Nepal from all Quad countries.The Quad ministers welcomed progress on key initiatives bolstering the prosperity of the Indo-Pacific.

. Gujarat is reaching out to the global business community ahead of the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit (VGGS) 2027, sending multiple delegations to important countries to invite investors and industry leaders to participate in the state’s flagship investment event.As part of this global campaign, a high-level Gujarat Government delegation visited Dubai and held a series of meetings with the industry leaders in the UAE; cutting across various sectors including oil & gas, logistics, financial institutions, manufacturing groups and real estate. The delegation also interacted with Indian entrepreneurs and the diaspora residing in the UAE, at an event organised by the Indian People’s Forum (IPF) UAE. The presentations by the State government were followed by an interactive Q&A Session wherein the delegation addressed the queries raised by the participants.The delegation had also covered the countries of Qatar and Oman, before concluding their Gulf visit in Dubai. The delegation was led by Lochan Sehra, Secretary, Labour, Skill Development and Employment Department, Government of Gujarat. She said that they got very good response from investment authorities from these three countries, especially from the oil & gas industries.The 11th edition of the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit will be held from January 10 to 12, 2027, at Mahatma Mandir in Gandhinagar. The flagship investment summit was conceptualised by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2003, when he was the Chief Minister of Gujarat. It was started with a vision of positioning the state as a preferred global investment destination. Over the years, it has evolved into a major international platform for investment promotion, business networking and strategic partnerships.

. Major US stock market indices ended lower yesterday. The Nasdaq Composite slipped 1.4 per cent, as investor sentiment was weighed down by corporate quarterly earnings and concerns over AI-related spending. The S&P 500 declined 0.3 per cent and the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost nearly 0.3 per cent.On the economic front, according to the advance estimate released by the US Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), third-quarter GDP increased at an annual rate of 3.4 per cent, up from 2.2 per cent in the second quarter of this year.A separate report by the BEA showed that Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.6 per cent year on year in September, up from 3.4 per cent in August. Core PCE inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 3.1 per cent, up from three per cent in August.

. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reported a sharp acceleration in bank credit growth, alongside a decline in interest rates on fresh loans and deposits during the month of September this year.According to the RBI’s latest data, non-food bank credit grew 19.1 per cent year-on-year as of 30th September, compared to 11.2 per cent in the corresponding period last year. Credit to the services sector recorded the highest growth of 28.3 per cent, while agriculture and industry registered growth of 19.5 per cent each. Credit to the personal loans segment grew 17.3 per cent, compared to 11.5 per cent a year ago.The RBI data also shows that the weighted average lending rate on fresh rupee loans declined to 8.51 per cent in September from 8.61 per cent in August. The rate on outstanding loans remained unchanged at 8.96 per cent. Interest rates on fresh term deposits also eased to 5.61 per cent from 5.67 per cent.According to provisional data released by the RBI, country’s services exports increased over 39 billion US dollars in September this year, up 7.2 per cent year-on-year. Imports rose 12.6 per cent to over 20 billion US dollars, resulting in a services trade surplus of around 19.2 billion US dollars.

. The Ministry of Education has extended the last date for submission of applications under the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) for the academic year 2026-27 till 15th November this year. The Ministry said that the extension would provide eligible students additional time to complete their applications on the National Scholarship Portal and facilitate timely verification by the concerned authorities.Students are required to complete their One-Time Registration on the portal before applying for the Scholarship. The portal, which has been open since 1st June this year, has received ninety thousand and four-eighty-three fresh and around two lakh renewal applications till 30th of this month.Eligible students studying in state government and government-aided schools and also schools managed by local self governments, receive twelve thousand rupees per annum, which is transferred directly to their bank accounts through DBT. Students who have already submitted their applications should ensure that the applications are verified by the concerned Institute Nodal Officer by 30th November and District Nodal Officer  by 15th of December.NMMSS is aimed at supporting meritorious students from economically weaker sections. The scheme encourages them to continue their education beyond Class VIII up to Class XII. The scheme provides one lakh fresh scholarships every year to eligible Class IX students who qualify in the selection examination conducted by the respective State/UT Governments.

. In Badminton, Indian shuttler PV Sindhu has advanced to the women’s singles final of the Hylo Open in Germany today. The second-seeded Sindhu defeated Anmol Kharb 21-16, 21-13 in an all-Indian semifinal. In the other semifinal, Denmark’s Line Kjaersfeldt produced an impressive comeback to defeat top-seeded Thailand’s Pornpawee Chochuwong 8-21, 21-19, 28-26 in a thrilling three-game encounter. Sindhu will now face Kjaersfeldt in the final to clinch the women’s singles title.Meanwhile, in the men’s singles, Lakshya Sen will take on France’s Toma Junior Popov in the semifinal tonight, with a place in the final at stake. Sen booked his place in the last four after a hard-fought 14-21, 21-17, 21-13 victory over Finland’s Kalle Koljonen.

. The Securities and Exchange Board of India, SEBI, is taking several steps to protect investors from online financial fraud and scams through social media.Speaking to the media in Kolkata, SEBI Chairman Mr. Tuhin Kanta Pandey said, the regulator is working to make investors more aware and ensure safer investments.As part of these efforts, SEBI is working with Google to introduce special verified badges on the Google Play Store so that people can identify genuine SEBI-related apps.SEBI has also started a WhatsApp channel on investor awareness in eleven languages, including Bengali.The SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check facility will help investors check and verify accounts before making transactions in the securities market.SEBI has also developed an artificial intelligence-based tool called ‘Sudarshan’. It will help identify violations and suspicious activities across social media platforms through a five-stage checking process.The regulator is also running the ‘Samajh ke Investing Simple’ campaign in different regional languages to help people understand investments better.In addition, the SCORES 2.0 portal has been introduced to help investors register complaints, including complaints related to financial fraud.Speaking about West Bengal’s economic growth, Mr. Pandey said the state’s economy is estimated to have grown by 7.6 per cent in the financial year 2025-26.He also pointed out that the number of investors from West Bengal in the securities market has increased significantly. The number has crossed 90 lakh, compared to around 12 lakh in the financial year 2014-15. Interestingly, around 36 per cent of these investors are below 30 years of age.He further said that more than 40 small and medium-sized businesses from West Bengal have raised over 1,400 crore rupees through SME Initial Public Offerings, or IPOs.These figures show the growing interest of people in the state’s financial and investment markets.Mr. Pandey said, investor awareness and protection remain SEBI’s top priorities. The regulator aims to make the securities market safer and help people make informed investment decisions.However the chairman made it clear that the revival of the century-old Calcutta Stock Exchange will depend on its ability to attract sufficient trading volumes, build a sustainable business model and make substantial investments in technology.

. The Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare will conduct the month-long fifth nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) campaign across the country from the 1st of next month. Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions Ministry said that this is the biggest-ever DLC Campaign undertaken by the Ministry. Electronics and Information Technology Ministry and UIDAI will provide technical support during this campaign. The Ministry said that the initiative will be adopted with a Whole of Government approach with the objective of reaching pensioners in the remotest corners of the country with focus on Face Authentication Technology. The Ministry said that face Authentication for Digital Life Certificate is a seamless and fast mode for DLC generation which can be used both on Android and Apple devices, making it easy and convenient for elderly Pensioners.The Campaign will be conducted in an Utsav mode by offering a bouquet of services such as Health Check-ups and Aadhaar updation for pensioners. Doorstep services to be provided to pensioners based on their requirement.

. India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal during the next three days. According to IMD, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe are expected to experience heavy rainfall today.MetDepartment has also predicted thunderstorms with lightning and gusty winds over East Rajasthan, Konkan, Goa, Lakshadweep, Madhya Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh today. Similar weather conditions are likely to prevail over Odisha, Rayalaseema, Telangana, Coastal Karnataka and South Interior Karnataka for the day.For Delhi, the Weather Agency has forecast a clear sky today.
